pages: Lennox S40 Smart Thermostat – Quick Start Tips Linking the S40 to your Dealer Account for Remote Access September 03, 2024 1. Linking the S40 to your Service Dashboard on LennoxPros during start-up On the “Dealer information” screen, enter ONLY your dealer id number (Lennox customer number). All additional dealer information will populate once the S40 is connected to the internet and registered a. Your Lennox customer number is: _______________ 2. Wi-fi – Connecting the S40 to the customer’s wi-fi network a. From the home screen, go to Menu > Settings > Wi-Fi > Turn Wi-Fi switch to ON > Click on Wi-Fi Network b. Decide which network you want to connect to. Press the arrow on the far-right side of the screen next to the lock icon to view the signal strength between the S40 and the consumer’s wi-fi network i. The wi-fi signal strength is the number next to “RSSI.” This number must be greater than (-70) for the S40 to maintain a connection to the consumer’s router ii. Press Join this network > enter the Wi-Fi network password > press Join > then Back iii. Never connect the S40 to a “Guest” network iv. A 2.4 GHz network is preferred over a 5.0 GHz network v. After a short time, under the “Thermostat Connectivity Status,” you should see (3) green checkmarks indicating that the S40 is connected to the Lennox server 3. Input the customer’s home information a. Menu > User Account > Home Info > Complete all home information 4. Set up the customer’s account a. Menu > User Account > Account > Create New Account > Complete all information > Scroll down to the bottom of the screen and check all desired boxes > Next i. Select “create new account” ii. Enter the customer’s email address iii. Enter the password that the customer wants to use iv. Open the smart phone app and log-in using the same credentials 1. If the smart phone app will not link up with the S40, click on “Generate Pin” v. When selecting “generate pin,” the customer will need to enter this pin on their smart phone when logging into the app to link the S40 to their app 5. Confirm that the customer’s S40 is linked to your dealer account during a service or maintenance call While on-site for a service or maintenance call where there is an S40, the technician should confirm that their dealer information has been entered in the S40. This only needs to be done for those S40’s that are not already showing up on your LennoxPros Service Dashboard. If you are not sure, it only takes a few seconds to check. a. To Check: Menu > Lennox Dealer Support Access > Local Lennox Dealer Info. > information > Confirm that your correct dealer information is present b. If your dealer information is not present: Enter it using the following menu path from the home screen: i. Menu > Settings > Advanced Settings > View Support Service Control Center > OK > Information > Dealer ID number > Enter your dealer ID#: ______________________ 1. Be sure to first clear out any existing Dealer ID# if you want to replace it with your company information 6. Turning on the permissions for remote access from your Service Dashboard on LennoxPros. This will allow you to view settings, maintenance reminders, service alerts, and give you the ability to make system programming changes remotely. THIS IS STRONGLY RECOMMENDED ON EVERY S40. With permission from the customer, at the time of installation, or during a future service or maintenance call, your technician should change the permission settings from NO to YES to allow for remote viewing and remote access a. Menu > Lennox Dealer Support Access > Dealer Support Access > then change each of the following from OFF to ON: Remote Sharing, Advanced Diagnostics and Troubleshooting, and Alerts and Notifications

7. Reconfigure the system after a new device has been added if the system does not recognize a device in the network, such as an iHarmony zone system, an iHarmony zone sensor, or a PCO3S a. Menu > settings > advanced settings > View Support Service Control Center > OK > Equipment Settings > Reset > Re-configure System > Yes 8. Heat Pump defrost termination setpoint MUST be changed on Heat Pump installations This can be found in the S40 dealer control center under the equipment section, then under the heat pump settings. a. Menu > settings > advanced settings > View Support Service Control Center > Ok > Equipment Settings > Heat Pump > Defrost Termination Temp > Change from 50°F to 90°F (90°F or 100°F is suggested for cold climates – a different setting may be more desirable for other climates) 9. Enabling Balance Points for dual fuel systems with a communicating heat pump and gas furnace It is not recommended to lockout a Heat pump at any ODT when it is installed with an AHU with backup electric heat. Balance Point settings can be found in the S40 Support Service Control Center under Equipment Settings. a. Menu > Settings > Advanced Settings > View Support Service Control Center > Ok > Equipment Settings > Thermostat > Balance Point Control > Enabled > Back: i. Change the High and Low Balance Points to the desired settings as agreed upon by the consumer and comfort advisor 1. When the ODT is > HBP, heat pump operation only 2. When the ODT is between the HBP & LBP, 1st stage heat is heat pump, 2nd stage heat turns off the heat pump and brings on the gas furnace 3. When the ODT is < LBP, gas furnace operation only a. HBP – default is 50 °F b. LBP – default is 25 °F 10. Add or remove non-communicating equipment in the future after the S40 has already been commissioned, such as a humidifier or non-communicating outdoor unit a. Menu > Settings > Advanced Settings > View Support Service Control Center > OK > Equipment Settings > Add Non-Comm > select equipment to add 11. Adding Smart Accessories – Smart Accessories MUST be setup using the Lennox Smart Technician App. a. Smart Accessories – Refer to the Installer Quick Start Guide that is provided with each device i. Smart Indoor Air Quality Monitor ii. Smart Room Averaging Sensor(s) iii. Wireless Extender b. Download the Lennox Smart Technician App from Google Play or the Apple App Store 12. Commissioning the System using Automated Tests or Manual Tests – perform during startup, service, or maintenance visits to save a performance report for access on LennoxPROs and at the S40 a. Automated Test: Menu > Settings > Advanced Settings > View Support Service Control Center > Ok > Tests > Automated Test > ( ) > Ok > Select All > Start b. Manual Test: Menu > Settings > Advanced Settings > View Support Service Control Center > Ok > Tests > Manual Tests > ( ) Ok > Deselect All > Select Desired Tests > Start 13. NOTE: Shortcut to the Support Service Control Center a. Press and hold the Lennox logo in the top right corner of the home screen for about 5 seconds 14. Consumer support a. https://www.lennoxsmartertogether.com/help/index.html i. Documents ii. Videos iii. FAQ’s b. Consumer support phone: 800-9-LENNOX (800-953-6669)
